component.name: USB Sanitizer
component.summary: High-Assurance NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 1 Compliant Data Sanitization Utility

description.p: USB Sanitizer is an enterprise-grade storage wiping and cryptographic audit certification suite. It implements multi-standard sanitization protocols including NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 1 Clear/Purge, DoD 5220.22-M, and BSI-GS with real-time sector entropy read-back verification and Ed25519-signed PDF audit certificates.
Initial enterprise release with multi-pass wiping, real-time thermal telemetry, and digital certification.
